mentions.name: poker-study
mentions.description: A custom poker study tool for range memorization. Inspired by GTO Wizard's range memorization tool, it lets users test custom/arbitrary poker ranges and import and simplify ranges from other sites. Every scenario is URL-encoded so links can be embedded in Anki decks, though the URL format is subject to future breaking changes.
mentions.problem: The author likes GTO Wizard's range memorization tool but wants to test custom/arbitrary ranges and import and simplify ranges from other sites, which it doesn't support.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My custom poker study tools:

https://poker-study.onrender.com/

I really like the range memorization tool from GTO Wizard, but want to be able to put in custom/arbitrary ranges to test. I also want to be able to import and simplify ranges from other sites.
